calendar.matters:
ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME
Off Calendar Jul-10-2012 Granted Per Written Order
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled this day for OSC hearing for Change of Name of a minor.
Dept. 514, Judge: Donald J. Sullivan, Clerk: S. Vantree, CSR: Sonia Wong, #11288
PetitionersHuan Yao Zhuang and Jin Xian Chen were present, in pro per as Guardian ad Litem for the minors Wei Jian Zhuang and Wei Kang Zhuang. The father presented proof of Daly City residency. The Court notified of this by the clerk.(i/c) Mother provided proof of San Francisco resiency. Petitioners were placed under oath and examined.
Sihong Ruan, sworn and acts as Cantonese interpreter for the petitioners.

Proof of Publication is in the file.
No objections to the proposed change of names were made at the hearing.
It appears to the satisfaction of the Court that all the allegations in the petition are true, correct and sufficient, and that the petition should be granted.

The Court grants the petition for Change of Name of the minors to Wei Jian Zhuang to John Weijian Zhuang and Wei Kang Zhuang to Luke Weikang Zhuang.
Decree Changing Name was submitted to and signed by the Court.
